watchFor: 辨認 MF／UF、逆滲透與紫外線的不同功能。
區分進水、產水與濃縮流。
把流程屏障與監測證據連結起來。
watchForEn: Distinguish MF/UF, reverse osmosis and ultraviolet functions.
Separate feed, product and concentrate streams.
Connect treatment barriers with monitoring evidence.
videos.before: 先列出三種不同的水質污染或量測指標。
videos.beforeEn: List three distinct water-quality contaminants or measurement indicators.
videos.after: 解釋為何單一膜元件不足以代表整套處理與品質保證系統。
videos.afterEn: Explain why one membrane is not the whole treatment and quality-assurance system.

guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 以新生水為觀察案例，學徒扮演水質工程師，沿進水、膜列、消毒、儲水與需求端追蹤水和污染物。
guides.conceptEn: Using NEWater as the reference, the learner acts as a water-quality engineer following water and contaminants through feed, membrane trains, disinfection, storage and demand.
procedure: 先點選「二級處理出水採樣站」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把流量改成1500 m³/d，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 270 kg/d。與基準 216 kg/d比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「前處理膜列」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把可用膜面積降成1920 m²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 50 L/(m²·h)。與基準 40 L/(m²·h)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「壓差與溫度儀表盤」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把 TMP升成0.20 bar，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 150 L/(m²·h·bar)。與基準 200 L/(m²·h·bar)比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「逆滲透產濃水分流」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把產水量改成80 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 80 %。與基準 75 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「產水導電度檢驗台」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Cp改成10 mg/L，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 98 %。與基準 99 %比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「濃水去向管線」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Qp改成80 m³/h，Cp固定，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2480 mg/L。與基準 1985 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「高壓泵電力表」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把壓差增成12 bar，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 0.5555556 kWh/m³。與基準 0.462963 kWh/m³比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「紫外線接觸區」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把假想強度降成1.5 mW/cm²，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 22.5 mJ/cm²。與基準 30 mJ/cm²比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「障壁驗證紀錄」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Nout改成1000，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 2 log10。與基準 3 log10比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
先點選「工業回用需求端」量測點並重現基準算例；接著只把Q2改成40 m³/h，其他條件不變，預測後重算得到 36.66667 mg/L。與基準 24 mg/L比較，說明改變的機制；若現場資料不符，依驗證項檢查假設，不能直接套用成設備設定。
procedureEn: Select the secondary-effluent sampling station measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only flow to1500 m³/d with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 270 kg/d. Compare with baseline 216 kg/d and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the pretreatment membrane train measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only active membrane area to1920 m² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 50 L/(m²·h). Compare with baseline 40 L/(m²·h) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the pressure and temperature panel measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only TMP to0.20 bar with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 150 L/(m²·h·bar). Compare with baseline 200 L/(m²·h·bar) and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the RO permeate/concentrate split measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only permeate to80 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 80 %. Compare with baseline 75 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the permeate conductivity bench measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Cp to10 mg/L with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 98 %. Compare with baseline 99 % and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the concentrate disposal route measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Qp to80 m³/h while holding Cp fixed with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2480 mg/L. Compare with baseline 1985 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the high-pressure pump energy meter measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then increase only pressure difference to12 bar with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 0.5555556 kWh/m³. Compare with baseline 0.462963 kWh/m³ and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the UV exposure zone measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then reduce only hypothetical intensity to1.5 mW/cm² with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 22.5 mJ/cm². Compare with baseline 30 mJ/cm² and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the barrier-validation record measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Nout to1000 with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 2 log10. Compare with baseline 3 log10 and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.

Select the industrial reuse demand measurement point and reproduce the baseline; then change only Q2 to40 m³/h with other inputs fixed. Predict and recompute 36.66667 mg/L. Compare with baseline 24 mg/L and explain the mechanism; if observations disagree, check the stated assumptions rather than converting the example directly into equipment settings.
evidence: 將同一總時窗切成三段，以各段平均流率 Qi（m³/d）、濃度 Ci（mg/L）與時長 Δti（d）算質量 Mi=QiCiΔti/1000（kg）；加總質量後除以總時長，得到平均負荷率（kg/d），再與相同總時窗的流量加權混合樣比對。在離線場景為「二級處理出水採樣站」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以產水總表與各膜列面積核對，另記反洗時間。在離線場景為「前處理膜列」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
比較相同溫度與流量的前後資料，測壓點須一致。在離線場景為「壓差與溫度儀表盤」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
校核Qf=Qp+Qc，檢查三支流量表的時間同步。在離線場景為「逆滲透產濃水分流」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以標準液校正導電度，並用實驗室分析驗證目標溶質。在離線場景為「產水導電度檢驗台」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
以進水、產水與濃水三點配對樣核對鹽負荷。在離線場景為「濃水去向管線」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
把高壓泵電表與產水體積在相同時窗相除，再列其他負載。在離線場景為「高壓泵電力表」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
比較燈強度、透光率與流量，指出單一探頭代表不了所有流線。在離線場景為「紫外線接觸區」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
紀錄檢出限，區分未檢出與零；檢查共同失效是否影響多個障壁。在離線場景為「障壁驗證紀錄」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
檢查流量權重與採樣位置，再用混合後樣品驗證。在離線場景為「工業回用需求端」建立證據表，把原始值、單位、時戳及修正值分開保留。
evidenceEn: Split the same total sampling window into three intervals. For each interval use mean flow Qi (m³/d), concentration Ci (mg/L) and duration Δti (d) to calculate mass Mi=QiCiΔti/1000 (kg). Sum the masses and divide by total duration to obtain mean loading (kg/d), then compare with a flow-weighted composite covering that same total window. Build an offline evidence table for secondary-effluent sampling station; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Reconcile total permeate with each train area and separately log backwash time. Build an offline evidence table for pretreatment membrane train; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare before/after data at equal temperature and flow with identical pressure taps. Build an offline evidence table for pressure and temperature panel; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
Check Qf=Qp+Qc and synchronize the three flow meters. Build an offline evidence table for RO permeate/concentrate split; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Calibrate conductivity with standards and verify the target solute with laboratory analysis. Build an offline evidence table for permeate conductivity bench; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Use paired samples of feed, permeate and concentrate to check salt loads. Build an offline evidence table for concentrate disposal route; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Divide high-pressure pump energy by permeate volume over the same interval and list other loads separately. Build an offline evidence table for high-pressure pump energy meter; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Compare lamp intensity, transmittance and flow, explaining why one sensor does not represent all streamlines. Build an offline evidence table for UV exposure zone; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Record detection limits, distinguish non-detect from zero, and inspect common failures across barriers. Build an offline evidence table for barrier-validation record; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.

Inspect flow weights and sampling locations and verify with a downstream mixed sample. Build an offline evidence table for industrial reuse demand; retain raw values, units, timestamps and corrected values separately.
pitfalls: 等時間採樣遇到尖峰流量會低估負荷，先檢查採樣權重。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
未扣停用膜列會低估剩餘膜列的真實通量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
堵塞與水溫下降都會降低比通量，先分離兩種原因。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
濃水表偏低會製造虛假的高回收，須做總水量平衡。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
膜破損、密封旁通與探頭漂移都可能使產水讀值上升。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
只計產水品質而不計濃水，會把污染轉移誤認成消失。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
用進水體積當分母會低估每單位產水能耗。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
套管結垢與水中懸浮物可同時降低有效光量。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
把未檢出當零會算出無限去除，失去可驗證性。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
混合未完全就採樣會得到隨位置不同的濃度。在場景中標出故障點及其影響的上下游證據。
pitfallsEn: Equal-time sampling during a flow peak can understate loading; inspect sampling weights first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Counting offline trains understates flux on the remaining membranes. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Fouling and colder water both lower permeability; distinguish these causes first. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
An under-reading concentrate meter creates false high recovery; close the water balance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Membrane damage, seal bypass and sensor drift can all raise the permeate reading. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Checking only permeate quality mistakes transferred pollution for disappearance. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Using feed volume as the denominator understates energy per unit product. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Sleeve fouling and suspended particles can both reduce effective fluence. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Treating non-detect as zero gives infinite removal and is unverifiable. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.
Sampling before complete mixing yields position-dependent concentrations. Mark the fault and the upstream/downstream evidence it affects in the scene.

courses.summary: PUB的新生水流程以膜處理和紫外線建立多重障壁；本課以公開流程重建教學模型，不複製任何廠的操作配方。
courses.summaryEn: PUB describes a multi-barrier process using membrane treatment and ultraviolet light; this lesson reconstructs an educational model without copying an operating recipe.

history.title: 新加坡新生水系統
history.text: PUB的新生水流程以膜處理和紫外線建立多重障壁；本課以公開流程重建教學模型，不複製任何廠的操作配方。
history.textEn: PUB describes a multi-barrier process using membrane treatment and ultraviolet light; this lesson reconstructs an educational model without copying an operating recipe.

courses.connection: 以新生水為觀察案例，學徒扮演水質工程師，沿進水、膜列、消毒、儲水與需求端追蹤水和污染物。
courses.connectionEn: Using NEWater as the reference, the learner acts as a water-quality engineer following water and contaminants through feed, membrane trains, disinfection, storage and demand.

roles.role: NEWater 再生水系統的業主（政府機構）。
roles.roleEn: Owner of the NEWater reclamation system (government agency).
roles.business: 新加坡國家水務機構，NEWater 再生水系統業主。
roles.businessEn: Singapore’s national water agency and owner of the NEWater reclamation system.

roles.role: 旗下 Hydranautics 生產再生水所用的 RO 逆滲透膜；屬產業關聯。
roles.roleEn: Its Hydranautics unit makes RO membranes used in water reclamation; an industry association.
roles.business: 材料集團，旗下 Hydranautics 生產逆滲透（RO）薄膜。
roles.businessEn: Materials group whose Hydranautics unit makes reverse-osmosis membranes.

roles.role: 大型 RO 逆滲透膜製造商；屬產業關聯。
roles.roleEn: Major RO-membrane manufacturer; an industry association.
roles.business: 碳纖維複材與水處理 RO 膜製造商。
roles.businessEn: Maker of carbon-fibre composites and RO water-treatment membranes.

courses.connection: 從「新加坡新生水系統」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Singapore NEWater System. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.

vendors.name: 新加坡公用事業局
vendors.business: NEWater 的水務主管機關公開流程與品質資料，供學習再生水服務鏈；不是把公營機關當成設備廠牌。 作為公開產品／服務的學習關聯，不是本課的採購或承攬名單。
vendors.businessEn: The water agency’s NEWater process and quality information explains the reclaimed-water service chain; PUB is an authority, not an equipment brand. This is a public product/service learning reference, not a procurement or contractor list for this course.

vendors.name: 日東電工
vendors.business: 聚合物偏振膜與光學薄膜的大型製造商，供應液晶顯示器用的拉伸碘摻雜偏振片。
vendors.businessEn: Major manufacturer of polymer polarizing films and optical films, supplying stretched iodine-doped polarizers for liquid-crystal displays.

vendors.name: 東麗
vendors.business: 碳纖維複材與水處理 RO 膜製造商。
vendors.businessEn: Maker of carbon-fibre composites and RO water-treatment membranes.
